item.title: Two Saks OFF 5TH locations on Oahu slated to close
item.description: A major retailer filed bankruptcy and will be closing the doors of many of its locations, including stores in Honolulu and Waipahu. This report comes just a few weeks after another popular retailer chain announced the shutdown of its Hawaii stores.
